title: PREPRINT: AXIOMS FOR MODEL FIDELITY EVALUATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on engineering simulation fidelity, defining it as the similarity between a model and a physical system. While it mentions the etymological roots of 'fidelity' (faithfulness and trustworthiness), it does so to establish a technical metric for model accuracy and reliability in digital engineering, without any component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
